checkCatchAll.description: Probe a random address to detect catch-all domains. Implies SMTP probing. Deep depth already includes it.
checkCatchAll.title: Detect Catch-all Domains

checkSmtp.description: Run the best-effort SMTP mailbox probe even at basic or standard depth. Deep depth already includes it.
checkSmtp.title: Check SMTP Mailbox

concurrency.description: How many addresses are checked in parallel. Higher is faster, but mail servers may rate-limit SMTP probes.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

datasetEmailField.description: Column name that holds the email address when datasetId is set.
datasetEmailField.title: Dataset email field

datasetId.description: Optional Apify dataset ID. The actor reads one email per item from datasetEmailField, verifies those addresses, and can carry the original columns into each record.
datasetId.title: Read emails from an existing dataset

emails.description: One email address per item. You can paste a list here or use the text box below; if both are filled, the actor verifies both. Duplicates are removed case-insensitively.
emails.title: Email Addresses

emailsText.description: Paste a list separated by new lines, commas, semicolons or spaces. Useful for CSV exports and email lists.
emailsText.title: Email Addresses (text)

includeDomainHealth.description: Add SPF, DMARC policy and common DKIM selector findings for each domain at standard or deep depth.
includeDomainHealth.title: Include Domain Health

includeSourceFields.description: When reading from a dataset, include the original row in sourceData so you can join the verification result back to your CRM export.
includeSourceFields.title: Carry source dataset columns

maxEmails.description: Upper bound on unique addresses to verify in one run. Anything beyond this is skipped and reported in the run summary.
maxEmails.title: Maximum Emails

maxEmailsPerDomain.description: Cap on addresses verified for the same domain. Extra addresses get an 'unknown' record explaining the cap instead of hammering one mail server.
maxEmailsPerDomain.title: Maximum Emails per Domain

maxRetries.description: Extra attempts for temporary DNS, connection and SMTP 4xx failures, using exponential backoff.
maxRetries.title: Max Retries

smtpTimeout.description: Connect and response timeout for each SMTP probe. Use a lower value for fast scans and a higher value for slow mail servers.
smtpTimeout.title: SMTP Timeout (seconds)

verificationDepth.description: Basic checks syntax, MX records and the A/AAAA fallback. Standard adds disposable, role-based, free-provider and domain-health checks. Deep adds a best-effort SMTP mailbox probe and catch-all detection.
enumTitles: Standard (+ disposable, role, free provider, domain health)
Deep (+ SMTP mailbox probe and catch-all)
verificationDepth.title: Verification Depth
